## 简体中文

- 修复订阅生成时规则集下载绕过全局代理设置的问题。规则快照、中国大陆 IP 主源及 APNIC 备用源、中国大陆域名列表统一使用全局资源出口策略，与资源中转、规则转换和出口测试保持一致。
- 订阅 URL 源明确使用所选代理；未选择代理时直接连接，不继承环境代理或全局资源出口。所选代理不可用时不回退直连，界面同步明确「直连」含义。
- 按全局出口策略及代理版本隔离规则缓存、网络列表缓存和订阅产物回退，避免配置变化后复用旧策略下的结果；保留规则源 User-Agent、下载大小限制和网络列表主备逻辑。

## English

- Fix rule-set downloads bypassing global proxy settings during subscription generation. Rule snapshots, the primary mainland China IP source and APNIC fallback, and the mainland China domain list now use the global resource egress policy, consistent with resource relay, rule conversion, and egress tests.
- Subscription URL sources use their explicitly selected proxy. With no proxy selected, they connect directly without inheriting environment proxies or global resource egress settings. An unavailable selected proxy never falls back to direct access, and the UI now labels this choice as Direct.
- Isolate rule caches, network-list caches, and subscription artifact fallback by global egress policy and proxy revision to prevent reuse of results from an earlier policy. Preserve rule-source User-Agent values, download size limits, and network-list fallback behavior.
